ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there are 5 gray semicircles of the same size, and their diameters are all on the same horizontal line. Above there are 3 upward semicircles, and the horizontal distances between adjacent upper semicircles are labeled 12 and 12 respectively. Below there are 2 downward semicircles. Between the left endpoint of the leftmost upper semicircle and the left endpoint of the first lower semicircle is labeled 22; the horizontal gap between the two lower semicircles is labeled 16; between the right endpoint of the second lower semicircle and the right endpoint of the rightmost upper semicircle is labeled 22. Reasoning: Let the diameter of each semicircle be d, then the radius r = d/2. Set the left endpoint of the leftmost upper semicircle as coordinate 0. The endpoints of the three upper semicircles are successively [0,d], [d+12,2d+12], [2d+24,3d+24], so the coordinate of the rightmost endpoint is 3d+24. The first lower semicircle starts from coordinate 22, therefore its right endpoint is d+22. The right endpoint of the second lower semicircle is 22 away from the rightmost endpoint, so its right endpoint is 3d+24-22=3d+2, and its left endpoint is 2d+2. The gap between the two lower semicircles in the figure is 16, therefore (2d+2)-(d+22)=16. Simplifying gives d-20=16, so d=36. The radius r=d/2=18.

raw_record.question_text: The diagram shows 5 equally big semicircles and the length of 5 distances. How big is the radius of one semicircle?

method.method_draft: Assign coordinates along the common horizontal diameter line. From the image, read that there are three upper semicircles separated by two gaps of 12, two lower semicircles, a left offset of 22 from the far-left upper endpoint to the first lower semicircle’s left endpoint, a middle gap of 16 between the right endpoint of the first lower semicircle and the left endpoint of the second lower semicircle, and a right offset of 22 from the second lower semicircle’s right endpoint to the far-right upper endpoint. From the text, use that all 5 semicircles are equally big, so they all have the same diameter d = 2r. Set the far-left endpoint of the first upper semicircle at 0. Then the three upper semicircles have endpoints [0,d], [d+12,2d+12], and [2d+24,3d+24]. The first lower semicircle starts at 22, so it ends at d+22. The second lower semicircle ends 22 before the far-right endpoint, so it ends at 3d+24-22=3d+2 and starts at 2d+2. The image labels the gap between the first lower right endpoint and the second lower left endpoint as 16, giving (2d+2)-(d+22)=16, so d-20=16, d=36, and r=18.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中有 5 个一样大的灰色半圆，它们的直径都在同一条水平线上。上方有 3 个向上的半圆，相邻的上方半圆之间分别标有水平距离 12 和 12。下方有 2 个向下的半圆。最左端上方半圆的左端点到第一个下方半圆的左端点之间标有 22；两个下方半圆之间的水平间隙标有 16；第二个下方半圆的右端点到最右端上方半圆的右端点之间标有 22。

推理：设每个半圆的直径为 d，则半径 r = d/2。把最左边上方半圆的左端点设为坐标 0。三个上方半圆的端点依次为 [0,d]、[d+12,2d+12]、[2d+24,3d+24]，所以最右端点坐标是 3d+24。第一个下方半圆从坐标 22 开始，因此右端点是 d+22。第二个下方半圆的右端点距离最右端点 22，所以它的右端点是 3d+24-22=3d+2，左端点是 2d+2。图中两个下方半圆之间的间隙是 16，因此 (2d+2)-(d+22)=16。化简得 d-20=16，所以 d=36。半径 r=d/2=18。
